body:

[burns13] In the critical information summary -
Information about the Service
Applies to purchases made after 11am AEST on 31st of March 2026. From 11am AEDT on 30/09/2026 the $250 with 280GB Mobile plan will change from 4G (uncapped) to 5G/4G with a 150Mbps download speed cap. All customers on active services will be upgraded automatically
[Hunt is On] Amaysim with Topcashback is a better deal.
[hamza23] Link for anyone interested , upsized cashback ends in 50 minutes or so so be quick.
Less data, but it has 5G, eSim and is cheaper after cashback.
[heeatseggs] Risk of cashback not tracking vs upfront discount
[Frozensage] does this come with 12 month free membershjip?
[heeatseggs] OnePass Membership while the mobile plan is active compared to old plans that were only 12 months.
[ndemos] The membership is free as long as you have your mobile plan attached.
[heeatseggs] Good timing, my existing one was about to recharge @ $200, was already considering porting out and back in for $149 but couldn't be bothered. But just found that Optus has a $13 for 28days esim, so I did that instead and will port back to the $139 in a months time.
From the T&Cs, this needs to be activated by 20/11/26.

[Surfer Dude] Can I tell you kids something crazy? Ever since I got a 5G compatible phone, I've manually disabled 5G and used 4G, have done it for years!
Why you ask? Because I don't need to stream 4K UHD videos on my 6 inch screen and I don't want it to keep switching between the two when 5G isn't available.
Plus 5G giving you covid and whatnot /S
